description: Push the CRM's current price and stock to the workspace's existing Amazon offers now; an hourly job does it anyway, so use it only when a change must reach Amazon before the next run. A price change — the product's own, its price list, or set_product_channel_price — reaches Amazon ONLY through this push (an instant update after an edit sends stock alone). Pass productIds after changing a set of products: their offers are looked up by SKU, which is far faster than the whole run; without productIds it is the same as the Amazon connection page's sync button and walks every offer on every store, which a single call often cannot finish. It runs only the directions the owner ALREADY armed (price push, stock push) and never arms anything: price only in the store's currency (with the product's Amazon channel price when one is set), stock only for products that track it and only for MFN offers (FBA stock is Amazon's). Offers Amazon shows on sale go first. A product taken off the channel or paused is skipped. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing. Returns matched (product × store pairs found), updated (sent and accepted), unchanged (Amazon already showed these numbers), failed, priceBlocked (no price in the store's currency), truncated (the offers were not all read) and notAttempted (the call ran out of time before these: call again — sending the same numbers again changes nothing on Amazon). Amazon applies an accepted change asynchronously, so the offer can show the old price for a while; check with inspect_amazon_listings refresh=true. The result echoes the workspace.

productIds.description: Only these products, at most 100 ids from search_products. Omit for every offer on the channel.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
